Version.Page.Title: 版本管理
Versions
Version.Page.Subtitle: 内置实例锁定一份代码，本地实例可以并存多个；在这里切换、检查依赖与清理目录。
The built-in instance pins a single copy of the code, while local instances can coexist; switch, check dependencies, and tidy up folders here.

The code is there, only the Node dependencies are missing. It cannot start until they are installed; no code will be modified.

Choose a package.json
Version.Import.WrongFile.Body: 启动器靠 package.json 里的 name 字段判断这是不是酒馆目录，选别的文件没法验证。
The launcher reads the name field in package.json to tell whether a folder is a tavern, so any other file cannot be verified.

The built-in instance is already managed by the Built-in tab; adding it again would give two entries pointing at the same code. Pick a package.json in another folder.

Version.Builtin.Card.Title: 内置酒馆
Built-in tavern
Version.Builtin.Card.Detail: 由启动器托管的唯一一份代码，只运行一个实例，不支持多开与版本共存。
The single copy of the code managed by the launcher. One instance only — no multi-open, no side-by-side versions.

The built-in instance uses a fixed data folder and port, so only one copy of the code is kept. To test several versions side by side, manage those folders as local instances.

Version.Builtin.Hint.Fresh: 将从「设置 → 下载」里选的通道拉取源码，并接着安装 Node 依赖；需要 Git 与 Node.js 已就绪。
The source is pulled from the channel chosen in Settings → Downloads, then Node dependencies are installed. Git and Node.js must be ready.
Version.Builtin.Hint.NotActive: 换版会覆盖代码并重装依赖，不改变当前使用的实例；换版后点右上角「使用内置实例」即可启用。
Switching overwrites the code and reinstalls dependencies without changing the active instance. Afterwards click "Use built-in" at the top right to activate it.
Version.Builtin.Hint.Staging: 开发版跟随 staging 分支，切换同样覆盖当前代码。
The development build follows the staging branch; switching also overwrites the current code.
Version.Builtin.Hint.Switch: 切换会覆盖当前版本并重装依赖，旧版本不会保留。
Switching overwrites the current version and reinstalls dependencies; the old version is not kept.
Version.Builtin.Note.Staging.Title: 开发版可能不稳定
Development builds may be unstable
Version.Builtin.Note.Staging.Body: 直接跟随 staging 分支构建，包含未发布改动，可能随时出现异常；可随时切回稳定版。
Built straight from the staging branch, so it contains unreleased changes and may break at any time. You can switch back to stable whenever you like.
Version.Builtin.Footer: 切换会重建代码目录，建议先在仪表盘停止正在运行的服务。
Switching rebuilds the code folder; stop the running service from the dashboard first.
Version.Builtin.Action.Refresh.Tip: 忽略缓存，重新从 GitHub 获取版本列表
